name: 金庸群侠传
group_note: Jinyong-themed mudlib (金庸群侠传), in-game titled 'The Story of Hero'. Two bugs fixed: feature/name.lpc's short() called capitalize(query("id")) unguarded -- crashes with 'Bad argument 1 to capitalize()' whenever an object reaches short() with no "id" property set, which happens for every one of this lib's ~49 bulletin-board clones because their data/board/*.o save files use a legacy compact binary encoding (magic bytes '#inh'/'?inh') that this driver's restore_object() can't parse; the resulting 'Illegal file format' failure zeroes the object's dbase mapping (including the "id" set moments earlier in create()) before throwing, so every look at a room containing a board crashed. Fixed by guarding short()'s fallback on stringp(id) instead of reformatting the ~49 legacy save files. Also seeded fluffos/Mud2026Adm as (admin) via adm/etc/wizlist. No Chinese-name/macro/command-table bugs found (is_chinese() already uses the correct Unicode codepoint range; check_legal_name()'s i%2==0 half-stepping under-validates non-Chinese characters at odd positions but never rejects a real Chinese name, so left as-is). Full registration->look->score->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass); admin flow verified via the visible 目前权限：(admin) display. Formatter reverted 3 corrupted files, all ASCII-art zone maps (d/huashan/map.lpc, d/shaolin/npc/obj/map.lpc and its d/shaolin/obj/map.lpc duplicate) -- same tokenizer-confusion pattern as sibling libs in this lineage.
